simplestorage.guide.page.1.title: Simple Storage
simplestorage.guide.page.1: Crates of every wood that hold nine stacks of food in layers, the Storage Crafting Table that keeps its grid on its top, chests, shulker boxes, chest carts and chest boats in three tiers with more slots and bigger stacks, and bundles
simplestorage.guide.page.2.title: Simple Storage
simplestorage.guide.page.2: and quivers in three tiers with the storage enchantments Drawer, Deep Pockets and Funnel.
simplestorage.guide.page.3.title: Crates
simplestorage.guide.page.3: Crates are open wooden boxes shaped like the composter that store up to 9 stacks of food in at most 9 different kinds; each kind is a layer, the newest on top, seen through the slats.
simplestorage.guide.page.4.title: Storage Crafting Table
simplestorage.guide.page.4: The Storage Crafting Table is a crafting table that keeps its 3x3 grid: closing the screen leaves the items where they are, and they lie flat on the table's top.
simplestorage.guide.page.5.title: Moved from SimpleBuilding
simplestorage.guide.page.5: The crates of every wood and the Storage Crafting Table, their block entities, recipes and recipe unlocks were SimpleBuilding's (simplebuilding:*).
simplestorage.guide.page.6.title: Moved from SimpleBuilding
simplestorage.guide.page.6: Old worlds load them under simplestorage:* through SimpleLib's id moves and save the new ids; placed crates keep their food and tables their grid.
simplestorage.guide.page.7.title: Creative tabs
simplestorage.guide.page.7: Own tab with the Storage Crafting Table, the crates and the guide.
simplestorage.guide.page.8.title: Creative tabs
simplestorage.guide.page.8: Without SimpleBuilding the table also sits behind the crafting table and the crates behind the barrel in the Vanilla functional blocks tab (switch addItemsToVanillaTabs); with SimpleBuilding its tabs list them in their old places.
simplestorage.guide.page.9.title: Creative tabs
simplestorage.guide.page.9: Switched off (SimpleBuilding's Enable Simple Storage), the tab and the Vanilla tab entries are empty; the blocks keep working.
simplestorage.guide.page.10.title: Chest tiers
simplestorage.guide.page.10: Copper chest -> Reinforced Chest -> Netherite Chest -> Enderite Chest: more slots per tier (27/36/45/54, double chests twice that), and from netherite on bigger stacks per slot (x2, enderite x4).
simplestorage.guide.page.11.title: Chest tiers
simplestorage.guide.page.11: Each step is done in the world with the sledgehammer and keeps everything inside.
simplestorage.guide.page.12.title: Shulker box tiers
simplestorage.guide.page.12: Shulker box -> Reinforced -> Netherite -> Enderite Shulker Box: the slots and stack sizes of the chest tiers (36/45/54 slots, x2 and x4 stacks from netherite on) in a box that keeps everything when broken.
simplestorage.guide.page.13.title: Shulker box tiers
simplestorage.guide.page.13: Upgraded in the world with the sledgehammer like the chests, but dearer: 10 blows and 2 pieces of material per step.
simplestorage.guide.page.14.title: Rare structure finds
simplestorage.guide.page.14: In newly generated structures a loot chest is now and then a better chest with double loot, and end city shulkers are sometimes reinforced, netherite or enderite.
simplestorage.guide.page.15.title: Bundles: Reinforced, Netherite, Enderite
simplestorage.guide.page.15: Simple Storage extends the vanilla bundle into a three-tier family:
simplestorage.guide.page.16.title: Bundles: Reinforced, Netherite, Enderite
simplestorage.guide.page.16: the Reinforced Bundle holds 1.5x as much (96 items), the Netherite Bundle twice that (192) and the Enderite Bundle three times as much (288).
simplestorage.guide.page.17.title: Bundles: Reinforced, Netherite, Enderite
simplestorage.guide.page.17: All three handle the same way, let you pick an entry with the mouse wheel and take the storage enchantments Deep Pockets, Funnel and Drawer;
simplestorage.guide.page.18.title: Bundles: Reinforced, Netherite, Enderite
simplestorage.guide.page.18: with SimpleBuilding also its Master Builder and Color Palette.
simplestorage.guide.page.19.title: Quivers
simplestorage.guide.page.19: Quivers are arrow bundles: they take only arrows and supply a bow automatically as soon as they sit in
simplestorage.guide.page.20.title: Quivers
simplestorage.guide.page.20: the off-hand, in the chest slot, in the hotbar or - with SimpleBuilding's Constructor's Touch - anywhere in the inventory.
simplestorage.guide.page.21.title: Quivers
simplestorage.guide.page.21: There are four tiers with the capacity factors 1, 3/2, 2 and 3: the Quiver and the Reinforced Quiver come from the crafting table, the Netherite and the Enderite Quiver build on them at the smithing table.
simplestorage.guide.page.22.title: Quivers
simplestorage.guide.page.22: Drawer, Deep Pockets and Funnel work on all four tiers.
simplestorage.guide.page.23.title: Placed bundles
simplestorage.guide.page.23: Sneak + right-click on a block with a bundle or quiver to set it down as a 3D bundle - on the floor (falls like sand) or hung on a wall. Sneak and look at it to see its top item floating above it;
simplestorage.guide.page.24.title: Placed bundles
simplestorage.guide.page.24: sneak + mouse wheel picks the item, right-click takes it out, and sneak + right-click with an item puts that item in.
simplestorage.guide.page.25.title: Backpacks
simplestorage.guide.page.25: Backpacks are storage you wear in the chest slot: four tiers from 9 to 50 slots, opened with their own key (default B) as your normal inventory plus the backpack's slots.
simplestorage.guide.page.26.title: Backpacks
simplestorage.guide.page.26: They can also be set down as a block and picked up again with everything inside. Deep Pockets gives them bigger stacks and Funnel automatic pickup;
simplestorage.guide.page.27.title: Backpacks
simplestorage.guide.page.27: with SimpleBuilding, Master Builder makes them a material source for the Building Wand and pick block and Constructor's Touch refills your hand from them while building.
simplestorage.guide.page.28.title: Storage enchantments: Deep Pockets, Drawer, Funnel
simplestorage.guide.page.28: Three enchantments for the bundles, quivers and backpacks:
simplestorage.guide.page.29.title: Storage enchantments: Deep Pockets, Drawer, Funnel
simplestorage.guide.page.29: Deep Pockets gives them more room, Drawer much more room for one kind of item, Funnel picks items up off the ground. None is in the enchanting table tag;
simplestorage.guide.page.30.title: Storage enchantments: Deep Pockets, Drawer, Funnel
simplestorage.guide.page.30: they go on at the anvil.

quests.simplestorage.start.welcome.descr: Craft or pick up a crafting table and claim the Simple Storage Guide as a reward. You can also craft it from a book and a barrel.
